evidence: instruction.md (3 paragraphs, frozen sha256 a31f3827...00ef matching manifest) reads as a first-person user ask with contractions and varied cadence: 'I'd like a small local playground...', 'The editor itself matters: I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source.', 'I want to keep the versions that work without losing a draft when another tab saves first.', 'I start it with node /app/server.js'. The newly appended sentence (instruction.md:7) 'Before you hand it over, please check it yourself the way I'll use it: type into the editor, run the code and save a snippet, and make sure nothing breaks.' is in the same register: polite request, contraction (I'll), informal phrasing ('hand it over', 'make sure nothing breaks'), tied to the user's own workflow; it is not a numbered acceptance list or a grader-flavoured QA directive, and it does not shift tone. No bullets, no shall/must table, no marketing gloss: grep for seamless|robust|delve|leverage|ensure|utiliz|comprehensive|intuitive|streamlin|em-dash over instruction.md and all six notes returned nothing; instruction.md contains zero 'must'. Notes keep the same first-person speaker ('I start it with...', 'That refresh must not touch what I'm doing', 'The burst lasts for as long as I keep typing at those carets, however slowly', 'whichever you prefer', 'Choices left to you'), so the voice does not change between instruction.md and the notes. Observation only (not a defect for this row): ui.md and behaviour.md are dense, spec-like prose with several 'must' clauses (behaviour.md 6, ui.md 4) and few terse fragments; that is expected detail for reference notes and belongs to row 1/6 scrutiny rather than voice. Adversarial check: a robotic rewrite (e.g., 'Ensure the deliverable is thoroughly validated via end-to-end testing') would fail this row; the actual sentence does not resemble it. This row is purely textual; no runtime evidence is required or claimed, and no Oracle/model/portal score is implied.
